To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the CARDAP framework is able to deliver significant benefits in terms of energy efficiency over naive data analytics approaches; 2) CARDAP is able to deliver a high quality of service in terms of data analytics accuracy; 3) the CARDAP platform is able to provide a flexible framework for distributed mobile data analytics; 4) CARDAP can be used in a number of distributed data analytics applications.
CARDAP is a novel scalable, energy efficient context aware data analytics platform.
CARDAP can deliver significant benefits to the mobile data analytics community by enabling the design and implementation of novel energy efficient mobile data analytics applications.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an efficient and scalable data analytics platform that can be used for real-time data analytics in the context of mobile crowdsensing applications.
developing energy efficient data analytics solutions for distributed mobile data analytics applications.
energy efficient data analytics and data delivery in the Fog.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

CARDAP has the potential to deliver significant improvements in energy efficiency in distributed online mobile data analytics applications, and is a promising platform that can be extended and improved to support a wider variety of use cases.
the CARDAP platform provides a novel approach to energy-efficient data analytics.
CARDAP is a novel platform for distributed mobile data analytics that can be deployed on mobile devices.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed CARDAP, a scalable and energy-efficient distributed data analytics framework that can be used for a variety of applications such as smart cities.

we have designed, implemented and evaluated a generic, flexible, and extensible, context-aware, component-based, scalable, and energy-efficient data analytics platform that can be used in complex distributed mobile applications e.g. crowdsensing in smart cities.
we have proposed a novel platform, CARDAP, for real time distributed data analytics in the Fog.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the design of distributed data analytics platforms for mobile environments needs to be cognizant of the energy constraints of mobile devices and the need for energy efficient solutions that can deliver the desired analytics results in a timely fashion.
energy efficiency can be achieved in mobile distributed data analytics by incorporating context aware data delivery strategies.
energy-efficient data analytics in the Fog can be achieved using a number of strategies.
